items.title: Vespper (YC F24) – SOTA Docx MCP
items.raw_excerpt:
Hey HN! We're Dudu and Topaz from Vespper ( https://vespper.com ). Vespper is an MCP that lets AI agents efficiently edit Word documents, powered by our fine-tuned model. It's currently 3× faster, 2× cheaper and more accurate than the closest alternative. Check out an overview of how the product works here: https://youtu.be/odKxsgPjzzw We came to work on this problem after spending a year building an AI document editor for pharma companies. Before that, Topaz(myself) was a senior SWE at Snyk, working on distributed systems, and Dudu was a deep learning engineer at Viz.ai, building computer vision models for stroke detection.
Our editor helped pharma companies generate regulatory documents (e.g. CSRs) to speed up their submissions. Initially, the output was Markdown, displayed in a WYSIWYG
